geopolitics_summary: Houthi control of Red Sea chokepoint risks LNG/crude disruption; EU sanctions on Russia face rollover delays; Ukraine energy infrastructure remains at risk.

themes.headline: Houthis tighten Red Sea chokepoint grip; oil prices rising
themes.why_it_matters: Red Sea transit risk elevates crude costs; higher fuel oil input increases marginal gen cost, supporting EU power spreads. TTF arb to LNG via crude parity also tightens.

themes.headline: Trump administration scraps EPA climate curbs for US power generation
themes.why_it_matters: Removes US coal-fired gen dispatch constraints, increasing US coal supply pressure. Lower US thermal coal prices reduce EU import cost, depressing EU power margins via fuel-switching risk.

themes.headline: EU fails Russia sanctions rollover; deadline extended one week
themes.why_it_matters: Delay signals potential fractures in energy sanctions consensus. If rollover weakens, Russian gas flow risk to EU diminishes (oversupply scenario); if hardened, scarcity risk returns. TTF volatility likely near deadline.

themes.headline: Trump says Ukraine, Russia agreed to halt energy infrastructure strikes
themes.why_it_matters: If ceasefire holds, Ukrainian gas transit resumed and energy shortage eases, reducing scarcity premium in TTF/power. Zelenskyy's skepticism signals material execution risk; monitor for contradictory strike reports.

themes.headline: US crude oil production on track for 2026 record at 13.8 million b/d
themes.why_it_matters: Record US oil output depresses global crude prices; lower fuel oil cost reduces EU thermal gen marginal cost, pressuring power prices and EUA via lower switching incentive.

watchlist: EU Russia sanctions deadline (extended ~1 week); watch for final rollover outcome.
Red Sea shipping incidents; monitor LNG diversion routes and TTF-Asian LNG arb.
Von der Leyen State of the Union speech; any energy/climate policy guidance.
US–EU trade & Canada ratification momentum; indirect upstream LNG capex signal.
